versions.text: Each oil tank must be tested under USAR.965, except that (a) The applied pressure must be 34 kPa (5 psig) for the tank construction instead of the pressures specified in USAR.965 (a). (b) For a tank with a non-metallic liner the test fluid must be oil rather than fuel as specified in USAR.965 (d) and the slosh test on a specimen liner must be conducted with the oil at 121°C (250°F); and (c) For pressurised tanks used with a turbine engine, the test pressure may not be less than 34 kPa (5 psig) plus the maximum operating pressure of the tank.
